يضطغن (form VIII)

# يَضْطَغِنَّ (yaḍṭaḡinna) /jadˤ.tˤa.ɣin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# يُضْطَغَنُ (yuḍṭaḡanu) /judˤ.tˤa.ɣa.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِ
